title: 第二十七章铁板一块！
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡的心跳的震耳朵。

    光收了。

    赶忙把炉口对着掌心，倒了出来。

    一件东西落进他手里。

    一柄剑。

    不再是锈绿的断口货，而是一柄通体清亮的小剑。

    剑身不长，约莫两尺，泛着淡淡的青光，上头还流转着细密的纹路。

    那纹路一动一动的，活的。

    叶凡的呼吸停住了。

    认得。

    这是灵纹。

    成型的法器才有的东西。

    也就是说——

    三件死透了的废铜烂铁，合成了一柄能用的下品飞剑！

    叶凡捧着那剑，半天没动。

    活了快一百岁，黑市上的飞剑见过不少。

    像样的下品飞剑，没有十几块灵石，根本拿不下来。

    而他手里这柄，是用一颗锻体丹换来的三件废铜，扔进炉子里头变出来的。

    一颗锻体丹。

    换十几块灵石。

    叶凡感觉自己的手都在发飘。

    强压着，没让自己叫出声。

    这山坳虽说没人，可万一呢。

    把那点狂喜死按在肚子里，蹲在原地，盯着手里的剑看了又看。

    灵识探进去。

    剑身里头，灵纹完整，灵气流转顺畅，半点磕绊都没有。

    货真价实的成品。

    叶凡试着用灵识一催。

    那飞剑嗡的轻颤了一下，离了他的掌心，悬在了半空。

    虽说飘的不稳，晃晃悠悠的，可它确实是飞起来了。

    叶凡盯着那悬在面前的剑，喉咙发干。

    成了。

    脑子里飞快的算了一笔账。

    废丹合丹药，三颗废丹换一颗成丹，他靠这个，囤了一百多颗。

    可丹药再值钱，一颗也就卖个几块灵石顶天了，卖多了还招眼。

    法器不一样。

    一件下品飞剑，十几块灵石。

    要是合出更好的呢？

    那价钱，翻着跟头往上涨。

    而废法器的货源。

    安庆远那条线，要多少有多少。

    叶凡越想，心跳的越快。

    这趟下山，本来还愁着怎么一村一镇的自己去淘换。

    结果倒好。

    吃顿饭的工夫，安家就把货源连销路一块儿送上门了。

    低价收废铜，他这儿一合，就是成品法器。

    转手卖出去，几倍、十几倍的利。

    这哪是修仙。

    这是开着印钞的炉子下山捡钱。

    叶凡蹲在山坳里，捧着飞剑，乐的肩膀直抖。

    可乐着，他又冷静下来了。这破剑也是真够费劲的。

    九十年的道行，最不缺的就是兜头浇自己一盆凉水。

    太惹眼了。

    要是真敞开了卖法器，三天两头往黑市上扔成品飞剑，那是什么动静？

    一个外门弟子，哪来这么多货？

    到时候不光是马得水那种货色惦记，怕是连安平城里头那些个大家族、散修，都得盯上他。

    光卖丹药都够招人眼红的了，何况是法器。

    财帛动人心。

    这道理，他比谁都明白。

    叶凡把那点发热的脑子按住。

    不急。

    把这门路捏在手里，货源稳住。
content_en:
Ye Fan's heart beat loudly.

    The light is gone.

    He quickly put the mouth of the stove into his palm and poured it out.

    Something fell into his hand.

    A sword.

    It is no longer a rusty green broken sword, but a small sword that is completely clear.

    The blade of the sword is not long, about two feet, glowing with a faint green light, and has fine lines on it.

    The lines are moving and alive.

    Mark's breathing stopped.

    Recognize.

    This is a spiritual pattern.

    Something that only formed magical instruments have.

    That is to say——

    Three pieces of dead scrap copper and iron were combined into a usable low-grade flying sword!

    Ye Fan held the sword and didn't move for a long time.

    Having lived for almost a hundred years, I have seen a lot of flying swords on the black market.

    A decent low-grade flying sword cannot be taken down without more than a dozen spirit stones.

    The handle in his hand was created by using three pieces of scrap copper in exchange for a body forging pill and throwing them into the furnace.

    A body-building pill.

    In exchange for a dozen spiritual stones.

    Ye Fan felt that his hands were fluttering.

    He suppressed it and didn't let himself cry out.

    Although there is no one in this mountain col, it is just in case.

    He suppressed the ecstasy in his stomach, squatted on the spot, and stared at the sword in his hand.

    Spiritual consciousness probes in.

    Inside the sword body, the spiritual patterns are complete and the spiritual energy flows smoothly without any stumbling.

    Genuine finished product.

    Ye Fan tried to use his spiritual sense to remind him.

    The flying sword trembled slightly, left his palm, and hung in the air.

    Although it was floating unsteadily and swaying, it was indeed flying.

    Ye Fan stared at the sword hanging in front of him, his throat going dry.

    It’s done.

    I quickly made a calculation in my mind.

    Combining waste elixirs with elixirs, three waste elixirs were exchanged for one adult elixir. He relied on this to stock up on more than a hundred pills.

    But no matter how valuable the elixir is, one pill can only be sold for a few spiritual stones. If it is sold in large quantities, it will still attract attention.

    The magic weapon is different.

    A low-grade flying sword and a dozen spiritual stones.

    What if we get a better one?

    The price keeps rising.

    And the source of scrap instruments.

    As for the line from Anqingyuan, you can get it as much as you want.

    The more Ye Fan thought about it, the faster his heart beat.

    On this trip down the mountain, I was originally worried about how I would go shopping in each village and town.

    The result was good.

    During the meal, Anjia delivered the supply of goods and sales to his door.

    Collect scrap copper at a low price, and once he combines it, it will be a finished magical weapon.

    If you resell it, the profit will be several times or more than ten times.

    This is not cultivating immortality.

    This is turning on the money-printing furnace and going down the mountain to pick up money.

    Ye Fan squatted in the col, holding the flying sword, his shoulders shaking.

    Happy, he calmed down again. This broken sword is really laborious.

    After ninety years of practicing Taoism, the most indispensable thing is to pour a basin of cold water on oneself.

    Too eye-catching.

    If they really started selling magic weapons and threw finished flying swords on the black market every few days, what would be the news?

    How could an outer disciple get so many goods?

    By then, not only people like Ma Deshui will be concerned about him, but even the big families and casual cultivators in Anping City will be keeping an eye on him.

    Just selling elixirs is enough to make people jealous, let alone magic weapons.

    Money moves people's hearts.

    He understands this truth better than anyone else.

    Ye Fan held down the heated brain.

    No rush.

    With this path in hand, the supply of goods will be stable.
